info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Healthcare Appointments Notes-v3-spec
info.description: The Healthcare Appointment Notes API provides access to essential notes related to healthcare appointments. This endpoint allows users to list all notes associated with specific appointments, enhancing the ability to track patient interactions and care history. Typical consumers include healthcare providers, administrative staff, and systems integrating patient management solutions. By utilizing this API, users can improve the continuity of care by ensuring that critical information is readily available when needed.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all notes linked to existing appointments. It serves as a way to review the additional information recorded during appointments, helping to provide better context for future references or actions.
